Map & Directions

The Middle East Campus is located in Al Khatem Tower, opposite the Abu Dhabi Global Market on Al Maryah Island. The island lies between Abu Dhabi’s downtown district, Al Reem Island and the cultural district on Saadiyat Island.

Get directions ↗

Arriving at Campus

Our campus is on the 29th and 30th floors of Al Khatem Tower in ADGM Square.

Travelling from Abu Dhabi’s airport takes approximately 30–40 minutes, depending on traffic. A taxi is a convenient way to reach the campus.

Before Your Visit

Contact our Operations and Campus Service team for help planning your visit or arranging any specific access requirements.

Accommodation

The INSEAD Middle East Campus does not offer on-site accommodation. Abu Dhabi has an extensive choice of hotels across a wide range of price categories.

Rosewood and Four Seasons are on Al Maryah Island, next to the campus. INSEAD has negotiated special rates; please contact Campus Services for details.

Programme Information

What does the programme fee include?

For INSEAD Executive Education programmes, the fee covers tuition, course materials, lunches on working days and the opening and closing dinners.

Travel, accommodation and other incidentals are not included.

Food and beverage

The published campus guide lists meals without alcohol in local restaurants from AED 30, and meals at international hotels that serve alcohol from AED 80.

Check current prices, taxes and service charges directly with your hotel or restaurant.

Accessibility

INSEAD is committed to ensuring that our campuses are accessible and inclusive for all members of our community. Accessibility is part of how we design our spaces, learning environments and communications.

Physical access on campus

The Middle East Campus is designed to be physically accessible and welcoming, in line with UAE Federal Law and Abu Dhabi accessibility standards. Accessible toilets are available on both levels, classrooms include dedicated accessible seating locations and lifts offer a range of accessibility features.

Learning and digital accessibility

Course materials and teaching approaches are adapted to support different learning needs. Listening aids are available in classroom settings, alongside Zoom accessibility features.

Accessibility audits have been completed on key learning platforms and the website, with improvements underway. The Office of Diversity and Inclusion works with Campus Services, Campus Development, Digital teams and other departments to support these efforts.

Specific Access Arrangements

For questions or to discuss your requirements, contact our Operations and Campus Service team.
